lines.emitted_text: nhkwnho unalenvhv ohstv nunhvnelv hsakwo akathinhohele ahskohi iyukwatinvtv atelv uthuki

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏴᏙᏗ ᏄᎲᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏁᏤ ᎠᏥᎾᏗᏅᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᎵᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎲᎢ, ᎠᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ.
lines.english: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
lines.emitted_text: ahsenho kohuhsti uhtytohti nuhvna kehsv iyuhsti unatlha'i unhetse atsinatinvtiyi ale utali'i ale tsuwetsi al nika'v kohuhsti uhv'i athayvhtiyinho

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ, ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
lines.english: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
lines.emitted_text: nhski iyuhsti atsinvhsitahsti elati utanvne'i ale utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i hskinalha'i hskitoliki hskikhahthita nikathvnho takvyakuyv'eli

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏤᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏪᎧᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎤᏪᎵᏎᎴᎢ.
lines.english: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
lines.emitted_text: nahskinho atsinvhsitahsti unalha'i uwetolitse'i ale uwekhanhe'i ale uthukv unelaki uwelihsele'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᏄᎪᏨ, ᎤᏩᏛᎮ ᎠᏏᏴᏫ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᏨᎯ ᎤᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᎠᎩᏏ ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ; ᎤᏂᏴᎮᏃ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏴᏍᎩᏴᎮᎢ; ᏍᏆᎫᏴᏏ ᏥᎬᏚᎦ, ᎤᏛᏁᎢ.
lines.english: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
lines.emitted_text: ahsenho nahski na atsinvhsitahsti unukotsv uwhahthvhe ahsiyvwi itsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti nahski unhetsvhi ukhuyv'ehtiyi ahskohitskwi akihsi tsunakvwalhohti uniyvhenho ale uyhvhskiyvhe'i hskwahkyvhsi tsikvthuka utvnhe'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏃ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏁ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᏍᎩᏙᎵᎩ ᏍᎩᎦᏘᏓ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᏓᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎵ.
lines.english: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
lines.emitted_text: itsulahanho ketsinvhsitahsti tulahskv elati utanvne utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehs'i hskitoliki hskikahthita nikatvnho takvyakuyv'eli

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏳᏬᎯᏳᏁᎢ, ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱᏉ ᏭᎶᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿᎭᏭᏴᏔᏁ ᎤᎫᏴᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
lines.english: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏁᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᎷᏤ ᎤᏂᏃᏁᎴ ᏧᏂᎾᏝᎢ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᏙᎸᎢ.
lines.english: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ ᏭᏯᏅᎲ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎬᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎤᏁᎳᎩ ᎬᏰᎵᏎᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏂᎯ ᏥᎬᏚᎬᎩ, ᏍᎩᏔᏲᏎᎸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
lines.english: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏝᏍᎪ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᎯ ᎦᎯᏯᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᎡᏍᏗᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎬᏯᏙᎵᏨᎢ?
lines.english: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏔᎳᏭᏎᏃ ᎤᎾᏝᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᏗᎾᏓᏍᏚᎲᏍᎩ ᎤᎫᏴᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᏥᏚᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
lines.english: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏅᏓᏨᏴᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎡᎯ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ ᎨᏒ ᏂᏗᏥᏙᎵᎬᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏟ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
lines.english: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
